name: Fosphenytoin
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: A prodrug hydrolyzed to phenytoin, phosphate and formaldehyde, with formaldehyde converted to formate. Phenytoin then undergoes CYP2C9/CYP2C19 metabolism before mainly urinary metabolite elimination.
